We evaluate three main dimensions: style transfer accuracy, content preservation, and fluency. We measure sentiment accuracy using Distil-BERT finetuned for sentiment analysis on the SST-2 dataset. Following prior work, we evaluate content preservation using BLEU score and embedding similarity against the input sentences. We use Sentence-BERT and cosine similarity for the embedding similarity. We use GPT-2's perplexity to estimate fluency.
